name: Moriya (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Moriya city emblem in white: a ring crossed by a horizontal bar, with a small pointed device at the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Moriya, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1966.

features.role: Moriya city emblem — a ring crossed by a horizontal bar, with a small pointed device at the bottom
